packageRules.description: Hold the TypeScript 6 API shim within the range the installed typescript-eslint 8.71.2 supports (peerDependencies: typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0; typescript-eslint#10940 tracks TS 7 compiler API support). Typecheck runs TypeScript 7 via @typescript/native. Revisit when the installed typescript-eslint supports a newer TypeScript.
TypeScript 7 native tsc, installed as an npm alias of typescript. Do not collapse this back into the typescript key; that key is the v6 API shim eslint imports.
